perspective:
Jose Castillo’s available information:

- He asked if she was okay; Patricia said it was “nothing really, just some personal stuff” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk; Patricia said she appreciated it.
- During a lunch break, he overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He brought up financial planning with her; Patricia said that could be helpful and that she had been overwhelmed with bills lately.
- He suggested they could look at budgeting tips together; Patricia thanked him and said she’d take him up on it.

- He told Patricia he didn’t mean to pry and respected her privacy; she said she didn’t think he was prying and felt grateful.
- He said he wanted to support her as a friend; Patricia said it meant a lot to have someone to turn to.
- Later, he sensed Patricia appreciated his concern but preferred to handle things privately.
- He asked about her weekend plans; Patricia said she was planning a quiet weekend at home and asked about his plans.
- He said he would probably read and relax, and again offered to be there if she needed anything.
- He continued to check in with her at work regularly and offered help even with small things like getting coffee.
- Patricia said she was busy but handling it, thanked him for checking in, and said having his support was great.
- He responded that they were all there to help each other out.
final_response:
Based on Jose’s perspective, in scenario 4 he shifted to lighter, less personal conversation by asking about weekend plans and changing the subject away from finances/concerns.
